assets.name: airfield
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite for a top-down RTS game OpenRTS. A military airfield for FOUR fighter aircraft, inspired by the USA airfield in Command and Conquer Generals. A long vertical north-south dark asphalt runway centered, FOUR empty clearly separated parking aprons arranged two on left and two on right, compact olive maintenance hangar at the far north edge, control tower, concrete rectangular foundation. NO aircraft or vehicles. Keep the runway and four parking bays clear. Aspect ratio square. Style: crisp hand-painted industrial RTS sprite matching weathered olive metal, gray concrete and yellow hazard markings, strict orthographic view directly overhead, NO isometric perspective. Single object centered with margin, readable at small game scale, genuine alpha transparency, no surrounding terrain, no logos, no watermark, no labels. Do not include a checkerboard pattern.
assets.normalization: alpha>128 bounds, aspect fit928 centered1024, preserve alpha

assets.name: rotor
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent top-down RTS animation overlay. Create ONE isolated spinning aircraft rotor blade assembly seen from directly overhead, centered on a truly transparent square canvas. Five broad narrow brushed gray metal blades around a compact dark mechanical hub, the blades have a subtle translucent circular motion blur between them. No outer duct ring, no craft, no background or checkerboard, no ground shadow, no text or magenta colors. Keep useful empty transparent margin.
